description: A window mixer that passes one of five inputs to its output and steps to the next one on every trigger, with a slew across each change

params.text: Sets the slew between the old and the new channel, 0 to 120,000 samples; 441 samples is 10ms at a 44.1kHz sample rate, and 0 turns the slew off
Picks how the next channel is chosen: forwards, forwards by 2, backwards, backwards by 2, ping-pong, or at random from the connected inputs leaving out the current one
Steps the window on to the next connected channel

inputs.text: A trigger steps the window on to the next connected channel
The signal for that channel, passed to the mix output while the window selects it
Adds to the advance mode knob, a mode per volt, so a -5 to +5V signal sweeps the modes

outputs.text: The selected channel's signal, with the slew applied across each change of channel
0 to 10V for the selected channel: 0V for A, 2.5V for B, 5V for C, 7.5V for D and 10V for E

notes: patch the signals into the channel inputs and a trigger into the trigger input; the window moves only on a trigger or a press of the button, and only between inputs that have a cable
menu: CV Param Mode sets how the mode input acts on its knob: Offset adds to it, Follow sets it directly, Attenuate scales the CV by the knob
